correctness.rationale: Every nontrivial subset yields an exact nonzero root input for d=K sin d; all outputs equal omega, all subsets are distinct by sign supports, yielding 2^N-1. For two clusters the complete weighted Laplacian spectrum is explicit. Potential zero eigenvalues reduce to q(d)=m/N or 1-m/N; q is nonconstant analytic on a compact interval with removable endpoint singularity, proving finitely many exceptions. Each regular preimage persists over a common open set by the inverse function theorem. The zero input is regular for K>1. Symbolic and numerical finite tests independently reconstruct the critical algebra but do not replace the infinite quantified argument.
